mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.name, l.wg_network_id AS wgNetworkId, w.name AS wgNetworkName, l.transport, l.entry_node_id AS entryNodeId, en.name AS entryNodeName, en.status AS entryNodeStatus, l.exit_node_id AS exitNodeId, xn.name AS exitNodeName, xn.status AS exitNodeStatus, l.hop_node_ids AS hopNodeIds, l.status, l.created_time AS createdTime, l.updated_time AS updatedTime, CASE WHEN l.hop_node_ids IS NULL OR l.hop_node_ids = '' OR l.hop_node_ids = '[]' THEN 2 ELSE 2 + JSON_LENGTH(l.hop_node_ids) END AS nodeCount, nw.ip AS entryWgIp FROM link l LEFT JOIN node en ON en.id = l.entry_node_id LEFT JOIN node xn ON xn.id = l.exit_node_id LEFT JOIN wg_network w ON w.id = l.wg_network_id LEFT JOIN node_wg nw ON nw.node_id = l.entry_node_id AND nw.wg_network_id = l.wg_network_id ORDER BY l.created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link WHERE wg_network_id = #{wgNetworkId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_link WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
